summary: Work Type feature testing complete. All backend APIs (onboarding options, health profile creation with work_type fields, priority area generation) working correctly. Frontend onboarding shows work type chips with proper conditional visibility for shift details. Supplement-plan shift preset selector works for shift workers when notifications enabled.

minor.issue: Fixed NoneType comparison bug in _identify_health_drivers - stress/sleep fields returned None instead of default values

details: GET /api/onboarding/options?lang=de returns work_types (6 options)
GET /api/onboarding/options returns shift_models (3 options: 2_shift, 3_shift, vollkonti)
GET /api/onboarding/options returns shift_types (3 options with default_times)
All work types have German and Italian labels
POST /api/health-profile with work_type=shift_work creates profile and returns 'Schichtarbeit-Ausgleich' priority area
POST /api/health-profile with work_type=night_work returns 'Schichtarbeit-Ausgleich' priority area
POST /api/health-profile with work_type=physical returns 'Körperliche Belastung ausgleichen' priority area
POST /api/health-profile with work_type=office does NOT return shift-related priority areas
Work type fields (work_type, shift_model, current_shift) correctly persisted in database
Shift work increases vitamin D deficiency risk score
Night work elevates B vitamins and magnesium risks
Italian labels present for all work types
Italian assessment includes shift work priority 'Compensazione lavoro a turni'
Step 2 (Lebensstil) shows 'Beruf / Arbeitsform' section
All 6 work type chips displayed (Büro/Normal, Homeoffice, Körperliche Arbeit, Außendienst, Schichtarbeit, Nachtarbeit)
Selecting 'Schichtarbeit' reveals Schichtmodell and Aktuelle Schicht sub-sections
Shift model options displayed: 2-Schicht, 3-Schicht, Vollkonti
Shift type options displayed: Frühschicht, Spätschicht, Nachtschicht
Yellow info banner appears: 'Schichtarbeit beeinflusst Schlaf, Stress und Nährstoffbedarf'
Selecting 'Nachtarbeit' reveals only 'Aktuelle Schicht' (no 'Schichtmodell')
Selecting 'Büro / Normal' hides all shift detail sections
Supplement plan page loads correctly for shift worker
Reminder settings panel opens
When notifications enabled, 'Schicht-Vorlage' selector appears for shift workers
Three shift preset buttons (Früh, Spät, Nacht) visible
Clicking shift preset updates reminder times automatically

critical_code_review_comments: data-testid attributes on work type chips in onboarding.tsx use data-testid={`work-type-${w.value}`} but React Native web may render differently - text selectors work reliably
Shift preset selector in supplement-plan.tsx only shows when reminders.enabled=true - this is correct behavior per design

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all work type and shift preset features working)
